title: Unique normalized identity lift
statement: Let L:C→D be left adjoint to U:D→C and let e:Y≅L(X). Suppose β:U(Y)→U(L(X)) equals U(e.hom). If there is exactly one t:L(X)→Y whose adjunction transpose followed by β is the adjunction unit at X, then every such normalized t equals e.inv.

source.place: Existing proved normalized_identity_lift helper of CondensedCompactSupportProjection, extracted to keep the geometric file within its compile-time limit; blueprint Step 15 identity normalization.

proof.text: The inverse of e satisfies the normalization equation: expand the adjunction Hom-equivalence as the unit followed by U(e.inv), substitute β=U(e.hom), and use functoriality and inverse cancellation. Uniqueness of the assumed normalization identifies any given normalized lift with e.inv. Mathlib adjunction Hom-equivalence formula, functoriality, inverse cancellation, and ExistsUnique.unique.

lean.statement:
theorem CategoryTheory.normalizedIdentityLift
    {C D : Type*} [Category C] [Category D] {L : C ⥤ D} {U : D ⥤ C}
    (ad : L ⊣ U) {X : C} {Y : D} (e : Y ≅ L.obj X)
    (β : U.obj Y ⟶ U.obj (L.obj X)) (hβ : β = U.map e.hom)
    (hu : ∃! t : L.obj X ⟶ Y, ad.homEquiv _ _ t ≫ β = ad.unit.app X)
    (t : L.obj X ⟶ Y) (ht : ad.homEquiv _ _ t ≫ β = ad.unit.app X) :
    t = e.inv
